title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: money and Past Due headers sort largest first
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has overdue bills on today's date.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-21 Fleet.
  • In {Vendor-A}'s group there are three open bills, {Document-A}, {Document-B} and {Document-C}: {Document-A} is dated 40 days ago, due 10 days ago, amount $300.00, open $50.00; {Document-B} is dated 20 days ago, due 20 days ago, amount $100.00, open $100.00; {Document-C} is dated 35 days ago, due 5 days ago, amount $200.00, open $150.00.
    For example: {Document-A} is S1-101, {Document-B} is S1-99 and {Document-C} is S1-100 (the app assigns the real numbers; the dates and amounts are the ones that matter).
  • Starting screen: A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Vendor-A}'s group expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Past Due" header.
  2. Click the "Past Due" header again.
  3. Click the "Amount" header.
  4. Click the "Amount" header again.
  5. Click the "Open Balance" header.
  6. Click the "Open Balance" header again.
  7. Click the "Open Balance" header a third time.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: rows inside each vendor group sort by Past Due, largest first: {Document-B} (20 days), {Document-A} (10 days), {Document-C} (5 days).
  • Step 2: smallest first: {Document-C}, {Document-A}, {Document-B}.
  • Step 3: rows inside each vendor group sort by Amount, largest first: {Document-A} $300.00, {Document-C} $200.00, {Document-B} $100.00.
  • Step 4: smallest first: {Document-B}, {Document-C}, {Document-A}.
  • Step 5: rows inside each vendor group sort by Open Balance, largest first: {Document-C} $150.00, {Document-B} $100.00, {Document-A} $50.00.
  • Step 6: smallest first: {Document-A}, {Document-B}, {Document-C}.
  • Step 7: largest first again, as in step 5.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R1, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices columns: “A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount, Open Balance.”
  • S2-R1: “Every column on all six reports sorts when its header is clicked, except A/P Unpaid Invoices' Vendor Name column (S2-N1). The columns are:”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
  • S2-R5: “On the grouped reports, a header click sorts the rows inside each group; the groups themselves never move (S1-R5, S1-R6).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

  • ar-ap-p1-click-the-total-header.png: figure "Click the Total header" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"
  • ar-ap-p1-a-p-aging-detail-opens-by-vendor-name.png: figure "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"

The design's own words:

  • "First click gives the useful order: money largest first. Second click reverses, third repeats the first. S2-R1, S2-R2, S2-R3, S2-R7." (caption of "Click the Total header")
  • "Buckets stay in fixed order; rows inside each bucket go by vendor name (was most overdue first). S1-R5, S2-R4, S2-R5." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name")
